findings.title: A prepare already awaiting the native worker does not select the closing-room fallback

locations.claim: Only calls entering after room.phase becomes closing return null. A call already awaiting the agent always translates rejection to DispatchUnavailable.
current() executes before prepare and after its result; closing the original room invalidates the latter check.
Native preparation precedes store.prepare, operation lookup, reservation and operation acceptance.
The resulting adapter failure is committed against the original dispatch claim and consumes its attempt.

Preserve open-room failures, scope checks, original dispatcher claim, original input/currentCase and all downstream grant/store checks. Do not add a general provider fallback or new submission identity.

reviewed_invariants.claim: Quiescence synchronously fences new attempts and awaits actual retained tasks without closing the store. Existing inspect/prepared reads remain available; a timed-out waiter does not free the task.

Native per-bearer fence is published before awaiting, bodies recheck it before acceptance, and in-flight accepts are awaited before history drain. Global quiescence fences new work, wakes and observes the original driver plus dispatcher calls; pending actual work remains retained after observation timeout.

acceptNative directly awaits #transaction through COMMIT or rollback/release, rather than returning an early timeout-wrapper promise. The per-bearer gateway Promise therefore tracks actual SQL completion.

Close fences native intake, observes publication and drains original input before agent close/read drain/revocation. Closing original-room input selects the deterministic background path rather than a new room worker.
Direct close preserves dependent source/result listeners while the current room drains, then observes both drivers before closing transport/storage tiers.
Start admission is fenced separately from borrowed case/bridge transport closure; runtime closes the application before those dependencies.

SIGUSR1 handler is installed before the runtime emits readiness. Requested quiescence emits a closed DTO bound to trusted original profile/PID/node epoch; shutdown includes retained quiesce settlement.

Node original-room close is observed before stopping the native worker or SFU. Replays preserve the exact original command/binding and cannot create another room; successful SDK closure, Node closure, SFU absence and actual reap remain separate observations.

Front preparation closes operator/rooms/SMS owners while App origins remain available; final close retires App only after front preparation. Startup failure starts preparation rather than prematurely closing App.

Launcher orders front preparation before global gateway quiescence, then final Parent close and child closure. Failed/cancelled observers retain actual task/child identity; settled failures receive bounded unsignalled retry pacing.
Only requested quiescence for the original validated ready PID/profile/node epoch can release the gateway barrier. A cancelled observer retains the same control task and live process.

intentional_limits.limit: The drain scans at most sixteen account-history rows before filtering the original provider/binding. Any nextCursor overflow fails closed even if that room has fewer inputs.

Blocked/exhausted processing, unresolved original receipts or grant expiry before preparation/reservation can retain Closing. A later retry cannot manufacture a new grant, operation identity or authority.

A bare Parent owns no external gateway quiescence proof. A caller composing a gateway must perform prepare_shutdown → gateway dispatch quiescence → final Parent.close, as the launcher does. Parent.close alone is not a universal distributed drain guarantee.

P2 channel-input acceptance is distinct from P1 durable-work acceptance. The repair protects normal End ordering; it cannot claim every accepted channel input eventually becomes accepted P1 work. Already accepted P1 work retains its own authority and recovery rules.

Finite close/observation budgets do not prove remote effects stopped. Unresolved owners and private files remain retained; a normal successful path is not universal fault-independent shutdown completion.

An actual local media close fulfills whenClosed(), calls model.roomSettled and render(); render invokes the original retirement check. No missing completion callback was found.
Retirement requires a known closed Parent result, the original local room settled and all retained request tickets settled. A cleanup_incomplete Parent observation cannot grant completion.

Only the initial End and a bounded post-Start replay are issued automatically; subsequent incomplete observations require explicit Retry End. No broad RTC/privacy lifetime reorder is recommended without a demonstrated need.
